description_for_human: Autonomous OS for VC analysts — ingest deal flow, run research, and draft investment memos.
description_for_model: EasyVC exposes MCP tools to list, search, and read venture capital deals, founder profiles, and extracted deck content from the authenticated user's workspace (list_deals, get_deal, search_deals, get_deal_context). When the workspace owner enables Agent Mode, additional write tools become available so an external agent can record its own research: create_deal, update_deal, upsert_deal_person, delete_deal_person, and update_memo. Call get_agent_mode to check whether write access is enabled. Authenticate with a bearer personal access token or via OAuth 2.1.
